scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:oxk && pnpm run lint:rs
scripts.lint:rs: pnpm run lint:rs:aarch64 && pnpm run lint:rs:armv7 && pnpm run lint:rs:x86_64
scripts.lint:rs:aarch64: cargo clippy --workspace --exclude webview_example --exclude xcomponent_example --target aarch64-unknown-linux-ohos --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:rs:armv7: cargo clippy --workspace --exclude webview_example --exclude xcomponent_example --target armv7-unknown-linux-ohos --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:rs:x86_64: cargo clippy --workspace --exclude webview_example --exclude xcomponent_example --target x86_64-unknown-linux-ohos --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.postinstall: cargo install ohpm-cli --version 0.3.0 --locked && pnpm run install:ohpm
